say:1:1034113001:1.text: Honeyberries look exactly like the berries on wisteria vines.
say:1:1034113001:1.source_cn: 渍心蜜果，它们长得和紫豆藤几乎一模一样……
say:1:1034113001:1.male: Honeyberries look exactly like the berries on wisteria vines.
say:1:1034113001:1.female: Honeyberries look exactly like the berries on wisteria vines.

say:2:1034113002:1.text: Although honeyberries are tasty, they're too juicy and spill everywhere when I eat them. That's why I prefer the ones on wisteria vines.
say:2:1034113002:1.source_cn: 虽然渍心蜜果的味道不错，可吃起来总是汁水飞溅，因此我更...
say:2:1034113002:1.male: Although honeyberries are tasty, they're too juicy and spill everywhere when I eat them. That's why I prefer the ones on wisteria vines.
say:2:1034113002:1.female: Although honeyberries are tasty, they're too juicy and spill everywhere when I eat them. That's why I prefer the ones on wisteria vines.

say:3:1034113003:1.text: But my favorite is skirtweed! If you brew it with Taran River water, you can make a fantastic blue-colored drink... pure elegance.
say:3:1034113003:1.source_cn: 不过我最喜欢的，果然还是裙草！用塔兰河水冲泡裙草，你就...
say:3:1034113003:1.male: But my favorite is skirtweed! If you brew it with Taran River water, you can make a fantastic blue-colored drink... pure elegance.
say:3:1034113003:1.female: But my favorite is skirtweed! If you brew it with Taran River water, you can make a fantastic blue-colored drink... pure elegance.

say:4:1034113004:1.text: On that note, I think I'll brew a cup right now!
say:4:1034113004:1.source_cn: 既然说到这，我这就要来一杯！
